data.credibility: Management frequently drops or revises major capex numbers and project timelines, showing low consistency. While they successfully delivered the MIBK, MIBC, and acetophenone commissioning in August, broader guidance for multi-year spending and major project completion dates has repeatedly slipped or vanished.

lines.line: Promised 3,000 to 4,000 crore 3-year capex; dropped topic without completion.
Promised FY26 capex of 1,500 crore; lowered then dropped.
Promised FY27 capex of 2,500 crore; dropped from subsequent reports.
Targeted MIBK/MIBC commissioning in Q4 FY26; delayed then dropped.
Targeted polycarbonate onstream December 2027; repeatedly delayed and slipping.
Scheduled MIBK and MIBC in Q2 FY27; delayed and status slipping.
Expected polycarbonate by June 2028; delayed and currently slipping.
Expected FY27 capex of 1,500 to 1,600 crore; currently pending.
Total project capex raised to 11,700 crore; status slipping.
Peak debt expected at 8,000 to 8,500 crore; currently pending.
Promised MIBK, MIBC, and acetophenone in August; successfully delivered.
Promised FY28 capex of 2,200 to 2,400 crore; currently pending.
Promised FY 2028-2029 capex of 2,500 crore; currently pending.

overrides.reason: The ledger history shows it was raised from 11,500 to 11,700 crore, but the target itself is active and being pursued, not slipping.

bull: Deepak Nitrite holds an estimated market share of more than 50% in India for Phenol and Acetone.
Operating cash flow was 88% of reported profit over 5 years, showing strong cash conversion.
The balance sheet remains lightly geared with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.27 based on borrowings of 1,762 crore against net worth of 6,475 crore.
bear: EBITDA margin has narrowed significantly from 28.7% in FY21 to 12.5% in FY26.
Net profit has compounded negatively at -6.6% a year over five years, alongside slowing 3-year revenue growth of -0.4%.
Management execution is volatile, marked by frequent project delays and fluctuating multi-year capex and peak debt targets up to 8,500 crore.
